Account background: existing Redwood customer since 2024. On Hosted API for non-PHI workloads; signed Dedicated pilot (US-East) in 2025 for clinical-triage POC. Renewal window Q2 2026 for Dedicated reserved capacity. Customer wants to expand Dedicated to EU region for EHR-accessing triage and to adopt Redwood Optimize for quantization/batching recommendations to lower per-token cost. Interested in a Private/VPC deployment for PHI workloads and an on-prem option for one surgical partner.

Key requirements summary:
- Workloads: real-time clinical triage chat (patient intake -> triage), downstream doc search for clinicians, summarization of visit notes, internal support assistant for clinicians.
- Latency/throughput: p95 latency target <= 250ms for triage chat (short responses), sustained concurrency target ~150 rps, daytime spikes up to 600rps (needs autoscale/burst).
- Cost sensitivity: aims to reduce per-token inference cost by ~25% vs current Dedicated config; wants Optimize to suggest quantization profiles and batching strategy.
- Model preferences: prefer validated open models with Redwood performance profile; experimenting with redwood-v2-medium and llama-2-70b-q4 for longer-context summarization; fallback model needed for degraded capacity.
- Security/compliance: HIPAA covered, require SSO/SAML, SOC2 attestation, KMS integration for key management, audit logging for all inference calls, data residency in US & EU for relevant tenants.
